tasks.description: Create a new organization by collecting organization name, subdomain/slug, and first administrator account details. This provisions an empty, isolated tenant workspace and signs the first admin into it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new organization, when onboarding is completed, then an empty tenant workspace is provisioned.
Given a new organization, when onboarding is completed, then the first admin is signed into the tenant workspace.

tasks.description: Implement default roles (Admin and Member) and allow tenant admins to define custom roles by selecting from available permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a custom role is created, then the role is added to the list of available roles.
Given a tenant, when a user is assigned a role, then the user's effective permissions are updated.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to invite new users by email and assign one or more roles to the invitation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a user invitation is sent, then the invitee receives an email with a link to accept.
Given a tenant, when a user invitation is accepted, then the user is added to the tenant with the assigned roles.

tasks.description: Record an immutable audit log of significant actions within a tenant, including user invited, user removed, role changed, permission changed, billing plan changed, API key created or revoked, and settings changed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a significant action is performed, then an audit log entry is created.
Given a tenant, when an audit log entry is viewed, then the entry includes who performed the action, what changed, and when.

tasks.description: Display per-tenant usage metrics such as active users, API request volume, and storage consumed, over a selectable time range.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when the usage metrics dashboard is viewed, then the metrics are displayed over a selectable time range.
Given a tenant, when the usage metrics dashboard is viewed, then the metrics include active users, API request volume, and storage consumed.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to view the current plan, see current usage against plan limits, and upgrade or downgrade the plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when the current plan is viewed, then the plan details are displayed.
Given a tenant, when the plan is upgraded or downgraded, then the new plan details are updated.

tasks.description: Allow tenants to configure SAML-based single sign-on so their users authenticate through the tenant's own identity provider.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when SSO is enabled, then users can sign in via SAML.
Given a tenant, when SSO is enabled, then the IdP metadata is captured.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to create named API keys scoped to their tenant, view the list of active keys, and revoke a key.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when an API key is created, then the key is added to the list of active keys.
Given a tenant, when an API key is revoked, then the key is removed from the list of active keys.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to toggle tenant-level feature flags to enable or disable optional product capabilities for their organization.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a feature flag is toggled, then the feature is enabled or disabled.
Given a tenant, when a feature flag is viewed, then the current state of the flag is displayed.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to request an export of their tenant's data, which is generated asynchronously and made available for download.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a data export is requested, then the export is generated asynchronously.
Given a tenant, when a data export is completed, then the export is made available for download.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to configure tenant-wide options such as organization display name, tenant subdomain/slug, default role assigned to new members, and default timezone.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a setting is updated, then the new value is saved.
Given a tenant, when a setting is viewed, then the current value is displayed.

tasks.description: Ensure that no tenant can read or write another tenant's data.
acceptance_criteria: Given two tenants, when one tenant attempts to read another tenant's data, then the attempt is blocked.
Given two tenants, when one tenant attempts to write another tenant's data, then the attempt is blocked.

tasks.description: Ensure that all admin actions are permission-gated via RBAC.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when an admin action is performed, then the action is checked against the admin's permissions.
Given a tenant, when an admin action is performed without permission, then the action is blocked.

tasks.summary: Record significant mutations in audit log
tasks.description: Ensure that all significant mutations are recorded in the audit log.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a significant mutation is performed, then an audit log entry is created.
Given a tenant, when an audit log entry is viewed, then the entry includes who performed the action, what changed, and when.

tasks.description: Send an email to the invitee with a link to accept the invitation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a user invitation is sent, then an email is sent to the invitee.
Given a tenant, when an invitee accepts the invitation, then the invitee is added to the tenant.

tasks.description: Create a named API key scoped to the tenant.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when an API key is created, then the key is added to the list of active keys.
Given a tenant, when an API key is viewed, then the key details are displayed.

tasks.description: Toggle a tenant-level feature flag to enable or disable an optional product capability.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a feature flag is toggled, then the feature is enabled or disabled.
Given a tenant, when a feature flag is viewed, then the current state of the flag is displayed.

tasks.description: Generate an export of the tenant's data asynchronously.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a data export is requested, then the export is generated asynchronously.
Given a tenant, when a data export is completed, then the export is made available for download.

tasks.description: Update a tenant-wide option such as organization display name, tenant subdomain/slug, default role assigned to new members, or default timezone.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a setting is updated, then the new value is saved.
Given a tenant, when a setting is viewed, then the current value is displayed.

tasks.description: Fix an issue where the data export is not downloadable after generation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant, when a data export is completed, then the export is downloadable.

tasks.summary: Migrate existing tenants to new RBAC system
tasks.description: Migrate existing tenants to the new RBAC system, ensuring that all admin actions are permission-gated via RBAC.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing tenant, when the tenant is migrated, then all admin actions are permission-gated via RBAC.
Given an existing tenant, when the tenant is migrated, then the tenant's roles and permissions are updated to match the new RBAC system.

tasks.summary: Write API documentation for API key management
tasks.description: Write API documentation for the API key management feature, including how to create, view, and revoke API keys.
acceptance_criteria: Given the API documentation, when the API key management section is viewed, then the documentation includes instructions on how to create, view, and revoke API keys.

tasks.summary: Write API documentation for feature flags
tasks.description: Write API documentation for the feature flags feature, including how to toggle feature flags and view their current state.
acceptance_criteria: Given the API documentation, when the feature flags section is viewed, then the documentation includes instructions on how to toggle feature flags and view their current state.
